Allah does not sleep, nor does it befit Him; He lowers and raises the scale, deeds are raised to Him by night and day, and His veil is light.
Allah descends every night to the lowest heaven, asking who will call on Him, ask of Him or seek His forgiveness, until daybreak.
None loves praise more than Allah, so He praised Himself, and none is more self-respecting, so He forbade abominations; He loves accepting excuses, so He sent the Book and Messengers.
None is more patient than Allah at hearing irksome things: people ascribe partners and a son to Him, yet He protects them and provides for them.
